text:
alex_support: 🚨 Escalation from ACME (customer reported). Intermittent SSE disconnects + partial final tokens returned + duplicate billing events observed. They say this began after last night's edge deploy. They attached a pcap and app logs. Quick summary below.

kevin_eng: Can you drop the pcap link, client timestamps, and the exact endpoint/model? I'll start by checking runtime and edge traces.

alex_support: pcap: s3://acme-uploads/pcaps/2204/stream-drop.pcap
endpoint: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-lite-2 (us-west-2)
client version: acme-streamer/1.4.2
app log snippet: `2024-11-21T16:12:29Z -> 200 chunk`, `2024-11-21T16:12:30Z -> 503`, `2024-11-21T16:12:31Z -> reconnect`, then client receives truncated final token. Also customer saw duplicate billing: two charge events for same user request id.

maria_obs: I ran an initial trace correlation — I see edge-proxy sending `RST_STREAM` to backend at 2024-11-21T16:12:30Z, immediately after a token-rotation event at 2024-11-21T16:11:00Z. deploy-bot shows an edge deploy around 16:10:50Z. Possible interaction between short-lived auth tokens + keepalive window shrink after deploy.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: edge/proxy v1.9.3 by ci/cd at 2024-11-21T16:10:50Z (sha: deadbeef).

sara_sre: Metrics: edge request queue length spiked from ~5 -> ~48 at 16:11-16:13, tail lat 99p jumped from 280ms -> 3.2s. Runtime showed increased KV cache misses and concurrent KV swap activity. Suggest blackbox replay: hold SSE connection open for ~90s, stream long prompts, and force a token rotation mid-session to reproduce.

alex_support: adding the minimal headers sample customer used:

```
POST /v1/stream?model=redwood-lite-2 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <short-lived-token>
User-Agent: acme-streamer/1.4.2
X-Request-Id: acme-req-20241121-81
Accept: text/event-stream
```

kevin_eng: I'll run a blackbox replay in staging. Repro plan: 1) open SSE stream with above headers 2) send 8k token prompt 3) rotate token at ~30s 4) observe whether edge issues RST or backend returns partial payload 5) capture pcap + traces. I'll also add an idempotency header to mimic customer retries.

maria_obs: For observability folks: traces to look for: trace-abc123, trace-def456. Query logs for `RST_STREAM` and `auth-rotate` around 16:10-16:13 UTC. Grafana query (approx): `sum(rate(edge_request_queue_length[1m])) by (instance)` then look at `edge.proxy.tail_latency_ms`.

alex_support: Another important note: billing duplicates appear when client retried the same request id after reconnect; the charge pipeline currently gets duplicate events if resume flow triggers a second finalize. Billing team was pinged (cc @billing-team) — we should add server-side dedupe on `X-Request-Id` or `idempotency-key` asap.

kevin_eng: Immediate mitigation: 1) Add a temporary gate to drop duplicate charge events server-side for requests with same id within 5m. 2) Patch edge to keep connections alive for additional 60s during deploy window. 3) Run blackbox replay and attach new pcap. I'll own the replay and edge patch. ETA EOD.

sara_sre: Owners: kevin_eng -> replay + edge patch; maria_obs -> correlate traces + dashboards; alex_support -> customer comms + collect app logs (full HAR + client timestamps). Billing follow-up: billing-team to implement dedupe and verify no double-billing refunds pending.

alex_support: I'll update ACME and share repro artifacts when kevin posts them. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
